title: Invertibility of the total right-derived unit of an exact functor
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories with chosen derived categories, and assume C has K-injective resolutions [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If F:C→D is additive and exact, its total right-derived unit F_K⋙Qh→Qh⋙RF is an isomorphism.

source.place: Lemma lemma-right-derived-exact-functor, especially part (4): every complex computes the total right derived functor of an exact functor.

proof.text: An exact additive functor preserves homology and quasi-isomorphisms, so it induces a functor D(F) on derived categories, with an invertible factorization F_K⋙Qh≅Qh⋙D(F).
An invertible factorization through localization exhibits D(F) as a right derived functor. Uniqueness gives RF≅D(F) compatible with the units.
The unit for RF composed with the uniqueness isomorphism is the invertible factorization above. Cancel this isomorphism to prove the original unit invertible.
